records.case_definition: Ireland HPSC provisional national weekly notification snapshot reconstructed from archived official PDFs. Only the report's current-week column is stored; uncatalogued weeks remain missing and are never zero-filled. Original HPSC report week labels are retained separately because older labels do not always equal ISO week numbers. This archive source is not merged with current NDH or annual series.
records.primary_source_label: Ireland HPSC Notifiable Disease Weekly Hub
records.provenance_note: Multiple registered series are not declared safely additive. The compatibility curve uses one representative series; inspect source_series for every retained definition.
records.source_labels: Ireland HPSC Notifiable Disease Weekly Hub; Ireland HPSC Weekly Report Archive; Ireland HPSC Annual Infectious Disease Statistics; ECDC Surveillance Atlas — Ireland Annual Baseline

records.case_definition: Ireland HPSC provisional national weekly notification snapshot reconstructed from archived official PDFs. records.case_definition: Ireland HPSC provisional national weekly notification snapshot reconstructed from archived official PDFs. Only the report's current-week column is stored; uncatalogued weeks remain missing and are never zero-filled. Original HPSC report week labels are retained separately because older labels do not always equal ISO week numbers. This archive source is not merged with current NDH or annual series.
records.primary_source_label: Ireland HPSC Notifiable Disease Weekly Hub
records.provenance_note: Multiple registered series are not declared safely additive. The compatibility curve uses one representative series; inspect source_series for every retained definition.
records.source_labels: Ireland HPSC Notifiable Disease Weekly Hub; Ireland HPSC Weekly Report Archive; Ireland HPSC Annual Infectious Disease Statistics; ECDC Surveillance Atlas — Ireland Annual Baseline

records.case_definition: Ireland HPSC provisional national weekly notification snapshot reconstructed from archived official PDFs. Only the report's current-week column is stored; uncatalogued weeks remain missing and are never zero-filled. Original HPSC report week labels are retained separately because older labels do not always equal ISO week numbers. This archive source is not merged with current NDH or annual series.
records.primary_source_label: Ireland HPSC Notifiable Disease Weekly Hub
records.provenance_note: Multiple registered series are not declared safely additive. The compatibility curve uses one representative series; inspect source_series for every retained definition.
records.source_labels: Ireland HPSC Notifiable Disease Weekly Hub; Ireland HPSC Weekly Report Archive; Ireland HPSC Annual Infectious Disease Statistics; ECDC Surveillance Atlas — Ireland Annual Baseline

records.case_definition: Ireland HPSC provisional national weekly notification snapshot reconstructed from archived official PDFs. records.case_definition: Ireland HPSC provisional national weekly notification snapshot reconstructed from archived official PDFs. Only the report's current-week column is stored; uncatalogued weeks remain missing and are never zero-filled. Original HPSC report week labels are retained separately because older labels do not always equal ISO week numbers. This archive source is not merged with current NDH or annual series.
records.primary_source_label: Ireland HPSC Notifiable Disease Weekly Hub
